[attribute-border]
=== `@border` Border (Frame) around a Table (NISO JATS table model)

Thickness, in pixels, of the border to draw around the table. A value of “`0`” indicates that the table has no border. (This attribute is based on and intended to be converted easily to the XHMTL `border` attribute.)

#### Usage/Remarks
Supplying the <<attribute-border,`@border`>> attribute without specifying a value indicates that the table has a border of the application’s default thickness.
##### Best Practice

Although the Tag Set can enforce only that this attribute contain any text, numbers, or special characters, Best Practice is to constrain this value to a counting number (positive integer).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-table,`<table>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Counting number| Thickness, measured in pixels, of the border around the table.
| Restriction| This is an optional  attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Sample

##### Setting table border off
[source,xml]
....
...
<table border="0" width="1800">
 <colgroup>
  <col width="4*"/>
  <col width="89*"/>
  <col align="center" width="6*"/>
 </colgroup>
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td></td>
   <td></td>
   <td>(ft)</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td align="center">(a)</td>
   <td>Insulated supply service drops limited to 300 V to ground</td>
   <td>10.5</td>
  </tr>
  ...
 </tbody>
</table>
...
....
